name: XLA_JERS_SR_LINE_ASSGNS_
description: This table contains line level assignment of supporting references to a journal entry rule set.

columns.name: APPLICATION_ID
columns.description: Functional area within a software suite of products. For example, Financials or Payroll.

columns.name: LN_SR_ASSGN_ID
columns.description: Internal identification of line supporting reference assignment.

columns.name: AMB_CONTEXT_CODE
columns.description: Context of the accounting methods builder.

columns.name: JERS_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the type of the journal entry rule set. The possible values are: C: owned and defined by the user. S: owned and seeded by Oracle.

columns.name: JERS_CODE
columns.description: Code of the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: EVENT_CLASS_CODE
columns.description: Code of the event class.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the event type.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the type of the journal line type assigned to the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: ACCOUNTING_LINE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the journal line type assigned to the journal entry rule set.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_TYPE_CODE
columns.description: Code of the type of the supporting reference header assigned to the journal entry rule set at the journal line level.

columns.name: ANALYTICAL_CRITERION_CODE
columns.description: Code of the supporting reference header assigned to the journal entry rule set at the journal line level.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: SEED_DATA_SOURCE
columns.description: Source of seed data record. A value of 'BULK_SEED_DATA_SCRIPT' indicates that record was bulk loaded. Otherwise, specifies the name of the seed data file.

columns.name: AUDIT_ACTION_TYPE_
columns.description: Action Type - have values like INSERT, UPDATE and DELETE.

columns.name: AUDIT_CHANGE_BIT_MAP_
columns.description: Used to store a bit map of 1s and 0s for each column in the table.

columns.name: AUDIT_IMPERSONATOR_
columns.description: Original Impersonator User.
